Sandbox_groundWorks_EnableCollapse_toolt: Loaded unsecured trenches, moats and basements can collapse. Complete B47ANCE'd Earthworks framing prevents collapse while the frames remain intact.
Sandbox_groundWorks_CollapseKills_toolti: A survivor inside a collapsing column is killed. Disable to evacuate survivors to a clear surface landing instead. Collapse never deletes stored items or bodies.
Sandbox_groundWorks_CollapseChancePerHou: Collapse chance per hour per depth level
Chance for one unsecured loaded column over an in-game hour, multiplied by its depth. Default 0.01 (one percent). Zero disables random collapse.
Sandbox_groundWorks_EnableAnimalTraffic_: Records animal wear on observed adjacent square transitions. Initial samples, animals in vehicles and travel discontinuities do not create wear.
Sandbox_groundWorks_EnablePlayerFootTraf: Records one foot-traffic contribution when a player enters a different ground square.
Sandbox_groundWorks_EnableVehicleTraffic: Records wear along supported installed-wheel trajectories. Multiple occupants do not multiply wear.
Sandbox_groundWorks_EnableUnoccupiedVehi: Samples a bounded batch of loaded unoccupied vehicles for supported wheel travel. Requires vehicle road wear to be enabled. Stationary vehicles do not add wear.
Sandbox_groundWorks_WearRecoveryPerDay_t: Amount of semantic wear recovered per unused in-game day when a worn square is next visited. Zero disables recovery.
Sandbox_groundWorks_EnableLiveOpenPit_to: Allows debug, admin, or this sandbox flag to punch an instant cavity. Hand-tool digging does not need this option.
Sandbox_groundWorks_EnableHandExcavation: Lets players dig trenches, moats, graves, pits, basements, burn pits and foundations with a shovel or pickaxe, then dig deeper, fill, pour water or concrete, and light burn pits. Default on.
